narrator.instruct: Fast, gripping, high-energy history storyteller. Excited and urgent, punchy emphasis on the surprising facts, brisk pace, no long pauses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: These World War Two tanks were full of air.

voice.instruct: Dramatic, amazed opening hook, hitting 'full of air' hard, like revealing a secret.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They belonged to a secret American unit called the Ghost Army.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In Europe, soldiers set inflatable tanks in open fields.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They played battle sounds and sent fake radio messages.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: From far away, the enemy saw a huge American force.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: About eleven hundred soldiers could pretend to be more than thirty thousand.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: While the enemy watched the fake army, the real troops moved somewhere else.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sometimes, a convincing trick can save lives.

voice.instruct: Warm but still excited, landing the final line with weight.
